english.title: Permit the use of a motor vehicle fitted with mixed tyres on front and rear axles
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which had two axles equipped with one or two single wheels, fitted with a

(A)_[diagonal ply tyre on its rear axle and a radial ply]_
(B)_[bias belted tyre on its rear axle and a radial ply]_
(C)_[diagonal ply tyre on its rear axle and a bias belted]_

tyre on its front axle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 26(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), having two axles each with one or two wheels, on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). It was fitted with

(A)_[diagonal ply tyre on its rear axle and a radial ply]_
(B)_[bias belted tyre on its rear axle and a radial ply]_
(C)_[diagonal ply tyre on its rear axle and a bias belted]_

tyre on its front axle.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
